newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - April 8.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - April 8.

text.p: * Shares of Motorola Inc traded at 61-1/8 after the closing bell Monday, up from their close at 60-1/4. After the close, Motorola reported first quarter earnings above Wall Street estimates.
* Advanced Micro Devices Inc was up 1-1/4 at 43 after the bell Monday after releasing first quarter results that exceeded analysts' expectations.
* In London, Intel Corp was up 7/8 at 146, International Business Machines Corp rose 1/4 to 132-1/2, and Texas Instruments Inc was up 1/2 at 86.

* Tobacco stocks inched lower in London, unsettled by the start of jury selection in the latest trial of a U.S. lawsuit against the industry. RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp was down 1/4 to 30-7/8 and Philip Morris Cos Inc fell 1/2 to 112-5/8.

* Shares of Office Depot Inc rose in after-hours trading Monday. Traders attributed the strength to a statement that the company and Staples Inc will fight the Federal Trade Commission's attempt to block their proposed merger. Office Depot traded at 14-1/2 after closing at 14. Staples closed at 22-5/8.
* SunTrust Banks Inc is expected to report first quarter earnings per share of $0.73, compared to $0.67 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 47.
* Columbia Gas System Inc is expected to report first quarter earnings per share of $2.87, compared to $2.99 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 57-7/8.
